hook: Noodle's first sleepover! You won't guess what came home with him.
visit: Help out at Sunny Biscuit's yard: fill the bowl, water the garden, make a wish come true!
sleep: Then tap Sleepover. Noodle packed a toothbrush!
night: That night, he's their guest, name tag and all. Pets for Noodle!
morning: Home by breakfast, with a diary page, and a crayon picture of them both!
letter: Sunny Biscuit gets a letter saying who helped, and taps Say thanks.
thanks: No chat, no messages. Just dogs helping dogs.
ask: Tag the friend your dog would sleep over with!
